title: Clairambault 531 — testament and Holstein marriage
contents: The Czarina’s disputed will and succession; the Holstein wedding and confidential comments on the duke’s reputation and ability to produce heirs.
fields: De Villardeau (Holstein letter, signed on p125); testament memorandum anonymous
214 code assignments: 44 letter codes, 170 in nomenclature; 43 corresponding offset pairs
Historical interlinear plaintext on pp77, 79, 81 and 123–124.

excerpt: Veue d’egayer ma lettre, mais parce que je sçais **qu’il est important qu’un ministre sache si un prince qui aspire à une couronne est en estat d’avoir des successeurs**.
translation: The purpose is not to enliven my letter, but because I know it is important for a minister to know whether a prince who aspires to a crown is capable of having successors.
